info.name: Reelo POS Integration
info.description:
Reelo enables merchants to leverage customer data and analytics to drive incremental revenue. Our next generation customer engagement and business intelligence platform empowers merchants to acquire customers by connecting with their Point-of-Sale (POS) system and to grow their business.

Over 4000 brands across 40 cities trust Reelo to transform their customer experience and engagement. With 20+ POS partner integrations, we work with restaurants, cafes, grocery & departmental stores, supermarkets, salons, spa, apparel, jewelry, and various other stores.

Getting Started

As Reelo’s POS integration partner, you can use our APIs to allow your merchants to collect customer details, manage their loyalty points, redeem rewards, capture orders, take feedback, etc. programmatically by connecting their POS system. Note that the loyalty program will be set up by the merchants on Reelo’s dashboard.

This document shows you how to get set up and start making requests to Reelo API.

request.description:
This url is to get all loyalty details about the customer that includes total points of customer, list of redeemable rewards.

  • customer_key*: String
    customer_key is unique branch key provided by POS.
  • merchant_id*: String
    merchant_id is unique branch key generated by Reelo and shared with POS.
  • customer_mobile*: Number
    Valid mobile number without any country code prefixes

response.name: Get customer loyalty details

request.description:
Send otp to customer to redeem points/rewards. Send otp for earning point if branch requires authentication when earn points.

  • merchant_id*: String

    customer_key*: String

  • phone*: Number
    Phone of customer for which the OTP is being requested.

  • points*: Number
    Mandatory if loyalty type is cashback

  • coupon_code*: String
    Mandatory if loyalty type is tier-based

• customer_key*: String
    merchant_id*: String

  • customer*: Object
    name: String
    mobile*: String
    Valid 10 digit mobile number starting with 6/7/8/9 along with country code
    email: String
    dob: String -> Format: DD/MM/YYYY
    anniversary_date: String -> Format: DD/MM/YYYY

    • transaction:* Object
      id*: String
      Unique id of alpha-numeric characters
      number*: String
      Bill Number
      sale_return: true/false
      reference_bill: {
      id: String
      bill_number: String
      order_time: String
      }
      discount: Number
      type*: String
      Order type -> dine_in/take_away/delivery/others
      source*: String,
      order source -> zomato, swiggy, roomservice, online etc
      payment_type*: String
      Mode of payment-> cash/card/UPI
      order_subtotal*: Number
      amount before discounts and taxes
      gross_amount*: Number
      Item total - amount after all discounts (Reelo as well as external)
      net_amount*: Number
      gross_amount + charges + taxes
      amount*: Number
      Final bill amount collected from the customer
      charges : Array
      any type of charges that you charge your customers (Eg. service charge)
      taxes: Array
      any type of taxes that you charge your customers (Eg. GST)
      items*: Array
      redemption*: Object
      reward_id: String
      id(coupon_code) of a reward that is redeemed. Mandatory for reward redemption
      redeemed_amount: String
      cashback amount that is redeemed. Mandatory for cashback redemption
      For any bill there will only one type of redemption either reward redemption(reward_id) or cashback redemption (redeemed_amount)
      order_time*: String
      order_from*: String
      table_number: String
      number_of_people: String
      POS/own_website/online_order

Definitions:
1. order_subtotal: amount before all discounts, taxes and charges
2. gross_amount : item total - after all discounts (Reelo as well as external)
3. net_amount : gross_amount + charges + taxes
4. amount : net_amount
5. charges (%) : any type of charges that you charge your customers (Eg. service charge)
6. tax (%) : any type of tax that you charge your customers (Eg. GST)
